title: GSE Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex three-seed training
purpose: Determine whether one jointly decoded circular phase and a closed positive gap simplex recover strict multi-exit geometry and transferable uncertainty well enough to establish the structural-semantic observation used by GSE-Graph.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 JCGS three-seed training: C01-C06 gradients, C07 checkpoint and refusal selection, C08 one zero-adaptation transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed failed COUST training and attribution used only as comparison.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: Exact S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds and the only gradient source.
worlds.selection: C07 selects each checkpoint and one refusal threshold; C08 is one final zero-adaptation transfer only.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Five causal frames at one-metre arc intervals. Deterministic world shuffle and circular rolls. One phase distribution and K positive gaps jointly generate the ordered set; singleton gap is 360 degrees; no class or loss weights.

teacher.source: Exact circular exit centers, residuals, widths and vertical profiles plus objective local axis and width/height/slope/curvature masks from frozen procedural geometry.
teacher.use: For cardinality K, targets are sorted counter-clockwise and compared under only K cyclic starts. Proper phase likelihood, gap localization/scale and periodically sampled geometry supervise one closed set.
teacher.valid_mask: Residual/profile at exact exits; width has an independent exit mask; global geometry uses its four-value mask.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid frames only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created; any later edge remains physical-traversal-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 gradients and fixed circular augmentation only.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 minimum total validation loss selects each checkpoint. Three-seed ensemble aligns only cyclic starts and selects maximum-recall refusal at exit precision at least 0.995; score is count confidence times phase concentration times bearing-scale confidence.
split.strict_test: C08 applies frozen checkpoints and the single C07 threshold once. C09/C10/M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: All seeds start from scratch. Older checkpoints are never loaded; COUST metrics are immutable comparison constants only.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 789650-parameter JCGS models. Cardinality chooses one phase distribution and K strictly positive gaps summing to one; cumulative decoding produces the complete circular set and binds exit geometry by periodic sampling.
methods.baseline: Frozen COUST: C07/C08 overall strict exact-set 0.4156/0.3870, K3 0.00240/0.00179 and K4 0/0.00433; confidence transfer failed.
methods.fallback: Any safety, K3/K4 recovery, registered baseline gain, geometry or system failure stops before node generation; no oracle count, wider matching, retry, seed selection or planner compensation.

acceptance.continuous_exit_set: One C07-selected refusal at one-to-one tolerance at most 2 degrees yields exit precision at least 0.995 and recall at least 0.50 on C07 and C08.
acceptance.cardinality: Raw count accuracy at least 0.80, deployed structural-action macro-F1 at least 0.80, and raw and safely accepted exact sets at least 0.50 on both.
acceptance.complex_structure: K3 raw/safe exact sets at least 0.40/0.30 and K4 at least 0.20/0.10 on both.
acceptance.baseline_gain: On both C07 and C08, overall, K3 and K4 strict exact sets improve by at least 0.05 absolute over COUST.
acceptance.exit_geometry: Safely matched bearing MAE at most 1 degree, opening width at most 3 m and vertical profile at most 1 m.
acceptance.global_geometry: Axis at most 10 degrees; width/height at most 2 m; slope at most 2 degrees; curvature at most 0.02 per m.
acceptance.system: Exactly 34110 optimizer steps; C08 checkpoint observations zero; C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner zero.

failure_policy: Any frozen-input, split, environment or evidence drift is a system failure. Scientific failure is sealed and stops node generation; no retry, seed selection, reweighting, wider matching or planner compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories and summaries; compact development predictions; set/refusal/cardinality/geometry/baseline-gain and per-world metrics; figures/source; environment, commands, logs, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential CUDA trainings plus frozen C07/C08 evaluation
